summary.headline: Bipartisan US bill would require frontier AI safety frameworks
summary.body: Two House members, Jay Obernolte and Lori Trahan, released a 269-page draft 'Great American AI Act'. It would require large frontier developers to publish safety frameworks, report critical incidents and undergo audits, while overriding state frontier-AI laws for three years; unions opposed it. Mandatory safety work strengthens Alignment & Control, lifting Protector God and Libertarian Utopia and pushing Conquerors down. Overriding state laws counts as a step back for Global Coordination. Nvidia also released an open-weight 550B model, Nemotron 3 Ultra, slightly spreading power. Benevolent Dictator overtook 1984 for third place. Horizon Balance rose 0.97 to 2.5.
summary.movers_note: Protector God +0.7 and Conquerors -0.7, from the Great American AI Act draft (+0.69/-0.69); Libertarian Utopia +0.6 from the draft (+0.50) and Nemotron 3 Ultra (+0.06).

events.title: Nvidia releases open-weight Nemotron 3 Ultra (550B MoE)
events.summary: Nvidia shipped Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-parameter open-weight mixture-of-experts model, on Hugging Face and its NIM platform.
events.reason: Mid/large open-weights release, reportedly still behind Kimi K2.6.
